reviews.one_line_contribution: A pre-registered ALFWorld measurement of what fraction of a retrieved procedural-memory bank's value is already held by a GEPA-optimized instruction written from the identical training episodes, identified by a task-type x episode-provenance crossover square (instruction provenance x bank provenance) and reported as an absorbed share A = 1 - Inner(I_own)/Inner(I_oth) plus a residual gain g(I_own, B_own), each with an interval and a truth table fixing which of six titles is claimed.
reviews.closest_prior_work: ExpeL (arXiv 2308.10144) is the work that most threatens novelty, and the proposal now concedes it: ExpeL distils training episodes into a prepended insights block AND retrieves trajectories, ablates each container separately against the full system, and does so in ALFWorld. That is a two-container redundancy measurement in this exact environment, in print since 2023. The proposal's remaining increment is provenance labelling (which episodes filled which container) plus pairing, token matching and CIs. EvoAgentBench (arXiv 2607.05202) supplies the qualitative headline (ReasoningBank +3.6 vs GEPA +1.2 on the same 528/267 trajectories), AutoManual (arXiv 2405.16247) and AutoGuide (arXiv 2403.08978) already rewrite ALFWorld experience as instruction text and show a compiled manual competing with retrieval, and MIPROv2 (arXiv 2406.11695) established the instruction-vs-demonstration split on one training set. One further prior the proposal never cites and should: the instruction-induction / APE line (Honovich et al. 2022; Zhou et al., Large Language Models Are Human-Level Prompt Engineers, 2022), which is literally 'compile demonstrations into an instruction' and is the substitution hypothesis in its original form. Taken together the qualitative claim, the ALFWorld setting, the compiled-block arm and the two-container ablation are all pre-empted; what is left is a number under provenance control, and the design is not powered to deliver that number (see strongest_objection).
reviews.strongest_objection: The design is well powered exactly where it is not novel, and under-powered exactly where it is novel. Everything the proposal concedes to ExpeL and EvoAgentBench (a two-container comparison of a bank against an optimizer-written instruction) is carried by rows 1-3 at n = 1,200 with two optimizer seeds. The one thing claimed as new -- separating 'the instruction absorbed THESE episodes' from 'the instruction learned this task type' from 'the instruction was told which types are coming' -- is carried entirely by three arms that the proposal itself de-thresholds: Ladder T's A_epi (row 4, n = 500, one seed, interpolated denominator, SE(A_epi) ~ 0.30, explicitly 'reported with CIs and not thresholded'), row 19's I_type contrast (n = 500, SE ~ 2.6pt, so only a >= 4.3pt gap is distinguishable and a CI covering zero is pre-registered as merely 'not excluding' the type-label rival), and row 17's B'_own, which risk 26 concedes answers a different question (whether the BANK is type-generic, not whether the INSTRUCTION absorbed these episodes). So on a clean pass the paper can report A and g -- quantities whose qualitative answer is already published -- while the episode-vs-type-vs-label identification that is supposed to be the entire contribution is descriptive only. A reviewer will say: strip the under-powered arms and this is ExpeL's ablation with paired statistics; keep them and they cannot bear a claim. Compounding it, the confirmatory conjunction is nearly unreachable by construction (endpoint E is declarable only when the observed residual |g-hat| <= 0.68pt, risk 34 says so), G3 at 9pt is called 'a deliberate coin flip', and A vs A0 are strongly correlated ratios sharing a numerator but judged against differently derived floors (0.2 vs a matched-gap null's 95th percentile planned at 0.25-0.30, itself estimated from the same n = 500 single-seed row 4 whose SE is ~0.30). Truth-table row 6 -- 'exactly one of A, A0 passes, the disagreement IS the finding' (title T3) -- is therefore a highly likely outcome driven by the authors' choice of two floors rather than by anything about memory, and shipping that as a finding would not survive review.
reviews.what_would_fix_it: Reallocate power rather than add experiments. (1) Make the novel identification the confirmatory endpoint: put row 4 (Ladder T), row 19 (I_type) and row 17 (B'_own) at n = 1,200 with two optimizer seeds and threshold A_epi / the Inner(I_type) - Inner(I_own) contrast, and pay for it by deleting the arms the proposal itself says carry no novelty -- row 11 (compile-once, conceded as replication of AutoManual), row 12 (J), row 16 (A_all, a diagnostic that gates nothing) and the whole third-denominator apparatus. If the design cannot afford a powered episode-vs-type test, the paper should say so and drop 'same episodes, two containers' from its title. (2) Collapse the co-primary pair: pick ONE denominator on principled grounds (A0 at the hand-written scaffold is the interpretable one) and report the others as sensitivity, so that row 6's 'disagreement is the finding' cannot fire on a threshold artifact. (3) Re-tune the retrieval budget k on dev separately at I0*, I_oth and I_own and report the absorbed share at each condition's own optimal injection volume -- the track brief's own measured prior is that injection VOLUME, not content, was the causal lever, and the design pins k across instructions of very different lengths. (4) Run pre-freeze obligation (1), the provenance/data-attribution crossover search, and read ExpeL's ablation table BEFORE writing the paper, not before submission; the novelty argument is currently conditional on a search that has never been run. (5) Cut the version-history scaffolding ('v5.2 said X, withdrawn in v5.3') and the six-title truth table down to a paper a reviewer can hold in their head.
reviews.missing_baseline: The bank retrieved at I_own with the injection budget k re-tuned at I_own. 'HELD FIXED THROUGHOUT' pins k to a single dev tuning run and holds it across I0*, I_oth and I_own, but the optimized instruction is a much longer prompt than the hand-written scaffold, so the memory-to-context ratio -- not just the memory content -- differs across every cell of the square and across A0's whole level gap. The track's own prior result, quoted in the brief, is that cutting injection from seven items to three eliminated the harm from the SAME bank, i.e. volume was the causal lever; and the proposal itself cites retrieval-pollution, context-competition and dilution findings (arXiv 2604.27003, arXiv 2608.15008). A reviewer will therefore demand the budget-matched arm: if the optimal k at I_own is smaller and re-tuning restores the bank's advantage, the 'absorbed share' is a statement about over-injection into a longer prompt, not about content moving between containers. Neither X_dist (row 8) nor M_shuf (row 18) covers this, because both are token-matched to B_own at the SAME fixed k. A second, cheaper omission: no Tier-0 arm anchors the setup to any published ALFWorld system on the official valid_seen/valid_unseen splits (that is Tier 1), so the 5-15pt literature prior the whole design is calibrated against is never verified in-house at Tier 0; risk 24 names this as a bridging assumption but leaves it untested at the tier that ships. Third, and pointed given the track's title: I2 (instruction optimized with the bank in context, row 13) -- the only arm that tests coupling in a track called 'Coupling Self-Editing Memory with Prompt Optimization' -- is demoted to Tier 1 and may not run at all.
reviews.preprint_collision: The check is unusually thorough in form -- dated scans (2026-09-03, prior 2026-08-21), 15 HuggingFace queries over 244 papers, by-id verification for 54 arXiv IDs, per-ID verification channel recorded, one PDF read in full with a committed SHA256, and a correction of a mis-scraped number (ReasoningBank +7 -> +3.6). It is far better than the norm and it makes real concessions rather than defensive ones: ExpeL's ablation is conceded as a measurement collision and 'nobody has reported the number' is explicitly withdrawn; EvoAgentBench is conceded as publishing the qualitative headline; AutoManual and AutoGuide are conceded as pre-empting the compile-once arm in this exact environment. But it has NOT established novelty, for three reasons the proposal states itself. First, all five pre-freeze obligations are UNRUN, including the freeze-blocking one -- the search for held-out-episode / data-provenance crossovers in the prompt-optimization, contamination and data-attribution literatures -- and that primitive is the whole of the claimed identification. Asking a reviewer to accept a novelty claim explicitly conditional on a search that has never been performed is asking for a conditional accept of an unconditional claim. Second, the scan's recall is demonstrably poor on precisely this framing: the two most damaging precedents (AutoManual 2405.16247 and AutoGuide 2403.08978, both ALFWorld, both pre-2026) were supplied by a reviewer, not found by the scan, which is direct evidence that the 2023-2025 window -- where 'rewrite episodes as instruction text' actually originates -- was not covered. The APE / instruction-induction line (Honovich et al. 2022; Zhou et al. 2022) is still missing from the scan and is a closer framing ancestor than several of the 2026 IDs cited. Third, arXiv is unreachable from the node, so every 2026 ID except EvoAgentBench rests on a single web-snippet channel and every 'confirmed absent from the paper' claim about a competitor is asserted from an abstract; one such snippet has already been shown wrong. I cannot name a specific recent preprint that makes exactly the provenance-controlled claim, but the correct reading is that the check has not looked in the place where such a collision would live, and an unsearched claim of novelty is a weakness. On the specific named live collision -- the unopened appendix of arXiv 2608.14036 for a token-matched compiled-block-vs-retrieval comparison -- the proposal is right that this would gut prediction 6, and it should be resolved before submission rather than listed as an obligation.

reviews.one_line_contribution: A pre-registered ALFWorld measurement of how much of a retrieved procedural-memory bank's value is already held by a GEPA-optimized instruction written from the *same* training episodes, identified by crossing instruction provenance with bank provenance across two task-type sets (the 'square') and reported as two numbers with intervals: an absorbed share A of the bank's task-type-specific advantage, and a TOST equivalence test on the bank's residual gain g(I_own, B_own) at the optimized instruction.
reviews.closest_prior_work: ExpeL (arXiv 2308.10144), and the proposal concedes it correctly in Related Work (0) and Risk 31. ExpeL's published ablation removes the prepended distilled-insight block and the retrieved-trajectory block *separately*, both built from one training pool, and reports each single-container condition against the full system in ALFWorld. That is exactly this proposal's two-container redundancy measurement, in exactly this environment, since 2023. What survives is narrow and correctly stated: ExpeL's two containers draw on one undifferentiated pool, so it measures redundancy between two representations of a corpus rather than absorption of specific episodes; it is unpaired, not token-matched, single-run, and its instruction container is a fixed extraction routine rather than a search-based reflective optimizer. The problem is that the size of that residual gap is unknown even to the authors, who state plainly that arXiv is unreachable from their node and that they have never read ExpeL's ablation table. A contribution whose entire margin over a 2023 paper is a table nobody in the loop has opened is not a novelty claim, it is a hypothesis about a novelty claim. Secondary threats the proposal also concedes: EvoAgentBench (2607.05202) already publishes the qualitative headline (ReasoningBank +3.6 vs GEPA +1.2 on the same 528/267 trajectories); MIPROv2 (2406.11695) established the instruction-vs-demonstration two-container ablation; AutoManual (2405.16247) and AutoGuide (2403.08978) already rewrite ALFWorld episodic experience as instruction text and show a compiled manual competing with retrieval, which retires the compile-once arm (row 11 / prediction 6) as replication.
reviews.strongest_objection: The design cannot reach its own headline, and the fallback it will actually reach is selected by the one statistic in the document that has no standard error. Two chained problems. (1) Survival arithmetic: the paper's title T1 requires clearing G0, G1 (>=5pt with LB>=2pt under *both* I0 variants), G2 (>=3pt on both seeds and both type sets with a local 32B reflector, which the authors themselves flag as at real risk against arXiv 2604.14585), G3 (>=9pt, which Risk 1 calls 'deliberately a coin flip'), G3b, G4 bracketing, G5 throughput and G6, and *then* a triple conjunction whose weakest link is endpoint E, the +/-3pt TOST on g(I_own, B_own), which by the proposal's own SE(g) = 1.41pt is declarable only when |g-hat| <= 0.68pt. Risk 34 concedes that a realistic absorption effect (share 0.6, 2pt residual) routes to T2, not T1. Multiplying honest per-gate pass rates against 50-80% power on A and a co-primary A0 the authors say is harder still, the modal output of ~990,000 model calls and 84 GPU-hours is one of the seven pre-registered fallback papers, most of which are descriptive ('the type-generic finding', 'the optimizer-failure paper', 'the residual-gain paper with bounded-loss CIs'). (2) Which fallback fires is decided by Rule M's 2/3 help/off bucket, which is a *column of the truth table*: with the shares passing and E passing, help-dominant gives row 1 and title T1 ('Full absorption'), off-dominant gives row 3 and title T4 ('no absorption claim'). Measurement and Noise Control gives standard errors for A, A0, A_all, g, R, A_epi, the inflation difference and every equivalence margin, but gives none for the help/off decomposition. It cannot: help(I) and off(I) are each paired differences with SE about 1.4pt, so the 2/3 share of a Delta-Inner that the design plans at roughly 4-6pt is not estimable at n = 1,200. The paper's headline claim and its exact negation are therefore separated by an unpowered coin flip, and Rule F is explicitly allowed to disagree with Rule M with the disagreement reported rather than resolved.
reviews.what_would_fix_it: Cut the ratio apparatus and buy power for the endpoint that answers the title. Concretely: (a) Make g(I_own, B_own) and the retention ratio R = g(I_own,B_own)/g(I0*,B_own) the sole primary, and demote A, A0 and A_all to secondary mechanism descriptors. The absorbed share is nearly redundant with E when E passes (G1 already guarantees the bank is worth >=5pt at I0*, so a null residual at I_own is itself the substitution result), and when E fails no strong claim is licensed regardless of A. Dropping A as primary deletes in one move the three-denominator problem, the mis-specification/repair channel, A_h(A0) = 0.16-0.22 sitting at its own acceptance floor, the matched-gap null, and the intersection-union overclaim Risk 25 already walks back. (b) Spend the freed compute (row 4's 4,500 episodes, row 16's 2,000, and the seeds sold from rows 6, 11 and 12) on n and seeds for rows 1, 2, 3, 6 and 19, which is what would move the +/-3pt TOST toward the +/-2pt margin the design admits it wants and would let row 19 (I_type) exclude rather than merely raise the type-label explanation at its current SE of 2.6pt. (c) Either power Rule M or demote it to a reported diagnostic alongside Rule F and Rule C; do not let an unpowered 2/3 bucket select between T1 and T4. (d) Report the acceptance floor for any surviving ratio with the sampling error of the null percentile it is read against; a 95th percentile estimated from an n = 500 single-seed row cannot be treated as a fixed threshold for an n = 1,200 endpoint. (e) Execute pre-freeze obligation (1) and read ExpeL's ablation table before submission rather than before the freeze; the novelty claim is currently conditional on searches that are all unrun.
reviews.missing_baseline: A length-matched instruction control. The grid token-matches every memory container against every other (B_own vs B_oth vs R_raw vs X_dist vs M_shuf vs C_all, all at the median per-episode injection length), but it never matches the *instruction* containers against each other. A GEPA instruction seeded from I0* and evolved over 350 rollouts is routinely several times longer than the seed scaffold, so part of the shrinkage in Inner(I_own) relative to Inner(I0*) -- which is precisely A0, a co-primary -- can be prompt mass and position rather than absorbed content: a longer instruction dilutes the relative weight of an injected block regardless of what the block says. The design needs I0* padded to I_own's token count with task-neutral prose (or I_own truncated to I0*'s length), and at minimum needs instruction token counts reported per cell as a covariate. I_type does not cover this: it is short, hand-written, and deliberately content-minimal. A secondary baseline a reviewer will also demand, given that the proposal's own nearest measurement object is Experience Distillation (2607.21051) with weights as the second container, is a LoRA fine-tune on the identical P_train episode ids as a third container; the 'no gradient access to the served model' scoping is an assumption about deployment, not a hardware constraint, and 2xA100-80GB will train LoRA on a 32B model.
reviews.preprint_collision: The check is unusually good as *process* and unusually bad as *result*, and the proposal is candid about both. Process: a dated scan (2026-09-03, prior 2026-08-21), 15 HuggingFace queries over 244 papers, by-id abstract verification for 54 IDs, a committed scan table, a self-reported correction of a web snippet that misstated ReasoningBank's Qwen gain as +7 against the PDF's +3.6, and reinstatement of five citations wrongly retracted in an earlier version. Result: novelty is not established. All five pre-freeze obligations are marked unrun, including obligation (1), the freeze-blocking search for held-out-episode/data-provenance crossovers in the contamination and data-attribution literatures -- i.e. the one search that would tell us whether the identification primitive this proposal rests on is already standard. The two most damaging precedents, AutoManual (2405.16247) and AutoGuide (2403.08978), were supplied by a reviewer rather than found by the scan, which is direct evidence the scan's recall collapses outside a six-month window, and it is exactly the pre-2026 window where 'memory as an instruction' originates. The nearest measurement collision, ExpeL's own ablation table, has never been read from source because arXiv is unreachable from the node, and the proposal states it would reduce the contribution further if that table reports a paired token-matched retention ratio. Every 2026 competitor's 'confirmed absent from the paper' claim except EvoAgentBench's rests on abstracts via a single web-snippet channel that has already produced one demonstrably wrong number. I cannot name a specific recent preprint that already runs the instruction-provenance x bank-provenance crossover, and I credit the authors for not pretending otherwise -- but an unsearched novelty claim is a weakness, and here the authors have pre-committed in writing to reducing the contribution to 'the ALFWorld measurement, the on-policy control, the item-level content check and the compiled-block comparison' if the unrun search lands. Reviewers should not be asked to accept novelty on a promissory note.

reviews.one_line_contribution: A pre-registered ALFWorld measurement of what fraction of a procedural memory bank's task-type-specific advantage (and of its total gain over no-memory) is already held by a GEPA instruction optimized on the identical training episodes, identified by crossing instruction provenance against bank provenance in a two-task-set square rather than by ablating two containers filled from one undifferentiated pool.
reviews.closest_prior_work: ExpeL (arXiv 2308.10144), and the proposal concedes it. ExpeL's published ablation removes the prepended distilled-insight block and the retrieved-trajectory block separately, both built from the same training pool, and reports each single-container condition against the full system in ALFWorld. That is the same two-container redundancy question, on the same environment, in print since 2023; the proposal's own Related Work withdraws its 'nobody has reported the number' sentence because of it. What survives is narrow: provenance labelling of both containers, pairing, token matching, a reflective optimizer with a search budget in place of a fixed extraction routine, and confidence intervals. Worse, the authors state (risk 31, and under Verification limits) that they have not read ExpeL's ablation table because arXiv is unreachable from their node, and that 'if that table turns out to report a paired, token-matched retention ratio, the contribution reduces further.' A reviewer cannot grant novelty over a paper the proposers have not opened. Secondary threats they also concede: EvoAgentBench (arXiv 2607.05202) already puts GEPA (+1.2) and ReasoningBank (+3.6) on the same 528/267 training trajectories, publishing the qualitative headline; AutoManual (arXiv 2405.16247) already compiles ALFWorld experience into a single manual that replaces per-episode lookup, which makes prediction 6 a replication; and the crossover/held-out-provenance primitive itself is disclaimed.
reviews.strongest_objection: The primary threshold is not floor-adjusted, so a 'pass' would print a title the number does not support. The proposal computes a per-denominator headroom floor A_h - the value each ratio takes under literally zero absorption - and reports A_h(A) = 0.06-0.12, A_h(A0) = 0.16-0.22, A_h(A_all) = 0.04-0.08. It then applies the same flat point threshold, 'point estimate >= 0.5', to A and to the co-primary A0, and prices the floor only into the lower bound (via each ratio's own null). The consequence is arithmetic: A0 = 0.50 against a floor of 0.16-0.22 means roughly 0.28-0.34 of genuine absorption plus 0.2 of pure headroom, while A = 0.50 against a floor of 0.06-0.12 means 0.38-0.44 of genuine absorption. The two co-primaries are asked for materially different amounts of real content at the same nominal bar, and the abstract's sentence - 'at least half of the bank's task-type-specific advantage is absorbed' - is simply false on the A0 branch at its own floor. The design had the right bar and deleted it: v5.1's 'A - A_h >= 0.30' is explicitly withdrawn ('the bar is the truth table's conjunction, and nothing else'), which removes the only quantity that means the same thing across the three denominators. Compounding this, the correction bracket that is supposed to make the floor unnecessary is inert at both ends: best-of-w (row 14, n = 300) admittedly under-corrects and flatters the hypothesis, and the conservative end (Ladder T, row 4, n = 500, one optimizer seed, interpolated denominator) has SE(A_epi) ~ 0.30, i.e. an interval roughly as wide as the effect being bracketed. So the headroom defense reduces to a multiplicative compression model the authors themselves call 'a model, not a law' - and it is the wrong model here, because bank help is concentrated on specific hard games rather than distributed uniformly over the residual, which biases A upward in exactly the hypothesis's direction. Second head of the same objection: the design is near-certain not to reach its own headline. G3 is described as 'a deliberate coin flip', power for A's lower bound is 80/70/50% at Inner = 10/8/6pt, A0 is declared 'the harder of the two co-primaries', and endpoint E is declarable only when |g-hat| <= 0.68pt against a gated 5-15pt raw memory effect. Risk 34 concedes the modal outcome is the narrower T2 title. An area chair pricing the expected deliverable is pricing a gate-branch report or a partial-absorption paper whose headline number carries the floor contamination above.
reviews.what_would_fix_it: Four changes, in order of importance. (1) Restore a floor-adjusted confirmatory bar: require (A-hat - A_h)/(1 - A_h) >= 0.5 per denominator, computed from the directly measured levels (rows 1, 3, 16), so that the same nominal threshold means the same absorbed content for A, A0 and A_all, and so that an A0 pass at its 0.16-0.22 floor cannot be reported as 'at least half absorbed'. The matched-gap null on the lower bound is a good addition but it does not repair a point threshold that ignores the floor. (2) Re-tune the injection budget k at I_own. Right now k is 'fixed by a dev tuning run' under the hand-written scaffold and then HELD FIXED THROUGHOUT, including in the residual-gain cells; the track brief's own established prior is that injection volume, not content, is the causal lever (seven items harmful, three items not). Add I_own x B_own at a small k sweep so that g(I_own, B_own) is the bank's value at its best budget under that instruction, not at a budget tuned for a different one. (3) Stop pooling the numerator and denominator across directions before forming A. The confirmatory A is 'computed from direction-pooled numerator and denominator', which is a ratio of sums, not a mean of ratios: with T_A at Inner = 12pt and T_B at 4pt, the pooled A is essentially T_A's A, on two sets the proposal itself says are 'not exchangeable, by design'. Pre-specify a per-direction ratio and a fixed combination rule. (4) Execute the freeze-blocking obligation (1) and read ExpeL's, AutoManual's and AutoGuide's evaluation sections before submission rather than before the freeze, and cut the grid to what two A100s can actually run - A0, the residual gain g, the type-label rival I_type and R_raw at n = 1,200 - instead of twenty rows whose throughput assumption is transferred from another task.
reviews.missing_baseline: A per-instruction injection-budget control: B_own read at a k re-tuned under I_own, rather than at the single k tuned once on dev under the hand-written scaffold and then held fixed in every cell. This is not a nice-to-have - the research track's own headline prior result is that injection volume, not memory content, was the causal lever (cutting seven retrieved items to three eliminated the harm from the same bank), and the ALFWorld literature the proposal cites (arXiv 2604.27003, arXiv 2608.15008) says excessive retrieval harms sequential decision-making specifically. If the optimal k under a longer, procedure-bearing I_own is smaller than under I0*, then g(I_own, B_own) is depressed by context competition rather than by absorption, which pushes endpoint E toward passing and inflates A0 at the same time; the study would print T1 for a budget artifact. Secondary omission, and it is a Tier-0 omission by explicit refusal (risk 29): {C_own, C_oth} x {B_own, B_oth}, a non-GEPA prose summary of the same episodes. Without it a positive result licenses only 'a GEPA instruction built from these episodes absorbs the bank', not 'any instruction written from these episodes does' - and AutoManual (arXiv 2405.16247) makes the latter the likelier reading, which means the arm that would decide between them is the one that was cut.
reviews.preprint_collision: The check is methodologically the strongest part of the submission - 15 HuggingFace queries, 244 unique papers, by-id verification for 54 arXiv IDs, an EvoAgentBench PDF read in full with a committed SHA256, and a self-correction of a web snippet that had misreported ReasoningBank's Qwen gain as +7 when the PDF says +3.6 - and it is honest enough to withdraw its own novelty sentence over ExpeL. I could not name a recent preprint that already reports an absorbed share under provenance control. But it is not thin in method and strong in result; it is strong in method and unverified on the one axis that carries the claim, and three things make it a weakness rather than a neutral. First, the single freeze-blocking obligation - searching the contamination and data-attribution literatures for held-out-episode and data-provenance crossovers, i.e. 'is a learned artifact's benefit specific to the data it was built from' - is explicitly listed as UNRUN, and the whole identification claim is conditional on it. Crossover and leave-out-provenance designs are standard in transfer and contamination work, so this is likely to land at least partially, and the proposal pre-commits to reducing the contribution in print if it does. Second, the scan's recall is demonstrably poor where it matters: the two decisive same-environment precedents, AutoManual (arXiv 2405.16247) and AutoGuide (arXiv 2403.08978), were supplied by a reviewer rather than found by the scan, because it was weighted to the last six months - and those are exactly the papers that already establish, in ALFWorld, that episodic experience can be rewritten as instruction text and that a compiled manual competes with retrieval. Third, arXiv is unreachable from the node, so every 2026 ID rests on a single web-snippet channel and every 'confirmed absent from the paper' claim except EvoAgentBench's is asserted from abstracts - including, critically, the assertion that ExpeL's ablation does not already contain a paired retention ratio. A novelty argument whose load-bearing collision is a table the authors have not read is not established novelty.
